title: Book an event or brand shoot in Chișinău
intro: A few lines about your event or business, the date and what you need — that’s enough. Within one working day I’ll tell you if the date is free and send a quote.

sessions.name: Conference
sessions.duration: Half day, full day or several days
sessions.includes: Keynotes, panels, audience, networking, branding. First photos for social media the same evening.

sessions.name: Seminar or workshop
sessions.includes: Speakers, participants, group work. Silent, no flash.

sessions.name: Corporate event
sessions.includes: Launches, team days, ordinary office days. Reportage for your website and annual report.

sessions.name: Speaker and business portraits
sessions.includes: A portable studio at your venue. Retouched portraits within 24 hours.

sessions.name: Aftermovie and Reels
sessions.includes: A 1–3 minute aftermovie plus vertical Reels for social media.

sessions.name: Instagram Reels and content
sessions.includes: Short vertical videos and photos for Instagram, built around your audience and message.

sessions.name: Brand and business photo shoot
sessions.includes: People, products, spaces, services. For your website, Instagram and everything else.

sessions.name: Monthly social media package
sessions.includes: A content plan, regular photo and video shoots, posts ready to publish. Volume and channels agreed together.

successMessage: Thank you. Your request is in. Within one working day I’ll tell you if your date is free.

successSteps.title: Within one working day
successSteps.text: I tell you if the date is free and ask about your goals.

successSteps.title: Clear terms
successSteps.text: Before booking, we agree timing, what you receive and the price.

successSteps.title: Date reserved
successSteps.text: Once confirmed, we build the shot list together.
